risks.title: Leverage Decay Risk
risks.body: The portfolio's high leverage exposure increases the risk of significant losses in the event of a market downturn. The 3x leverage amplifies both gains and losses, making it essential to monitor the portfolio's performance closely.

risks.title: FX Drag Risk
risks.body: The portfolio's significant USD exposure increases the risk of losses due to currency fluctuations. A strengthening CAD could negatively impact the portfolio's value, while a weakening CAD could positively impact the portfolio's value.

risks.title: Earnings Concentration Risk
risks.body: The portfolio's concentration in the tech sector increases the risk of significant losses if the sector experiences a downturn. However, the portfolio's diversification across various sectors and industries mitigates this risk to some extent.
